summary:
The floor can and should drop from glibc 2.29 to 2.17. That covers CentOS/RHEL 7+, Debian 8+, Ubuntu 14.04+ and everything newer. The clean way to get there is to build all three lines inside quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_i686 (CentOS 7 i686 userland, glibc 2.17, devtoolset-10 GCC 10.2.1). Link libstdc++ statically and hide it, following upstream's own fix.

What sets the floor:
- **The game server itself sets almost no floor.** The v34 server binaries need at most GLIBC_2.3.2. Only steamclient.so needs a 32-bit libstdc++.so.6 (GLIBCXX_3.4 / CXXABI_1.3). So the floor comes entirely from the SourceMod (SM) and Metamod:Source (MM) packages.
- **rom4s packages:** floor 2.12 (pthread_setname_np).
- **Official AlliedModders drops:** SM 6970 is 2.17. SM 7255/7477 and MM 1227/1476 are 2.29–2.30, because they are built on Debian 11 with clang 22 and libstdc++ 10.2.
- **Our current packages:** 2.29 on every line. The causes are libm log/pow/exp@2.29 and logf/powf/expf@2.27 almost everywhere, fcntl/fcntl64@2.28, getentropy@2.25 (MySQL extension via Debian's static OpenSSL), explicit_bzero@2.25 (PostgreSQL extension), and spcomp needing GLIBCXX_3.4.26. On Ubuntu 18.04, the published sm13-latest metamod.2.ep1.so fails with "GLIBC_2.29 not found" and srcds exits.

What I built and tested in manylinux2014_i686 (only a few toolchain tweaks to a copy of the builder):
- **SM 1.13.0.7472 + MM 1.12 git1226 with real -std=c++20.** No C++17 downgrade, no span polyfill. Max GLIBC_2.17. check-package.sh passes. Smoke passes on CentOS 7, Ubuntu 14.04, 16.04, 18.04 and 24.04, and Debian 8, 9, 10 and 13.
- **SM 1.12.0.7253 + MM 1.12.** Floor 2.17. Smoke passes on CentOS 7, Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13.
- **SM 1.11.0.6970 + MM 1.10.7 (the frozen 1.11 line).** Floor 2.17. Smoke passes on CentOS 7, Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13. Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13 are exactly where the published sm11 build SIGABRTs.
- None of these needed the clang-9 binaries from bitbucket, the jessie gcc-4.9 sysroot, or the C++17 downgrade.

Why the sm11 build crashes, and the two fixes it needed:
- **The crash needs two ingredients together.** Our MM 1.10.7 binaries (server.so, metamod.1.ep1.so) load libstdc++.so.6 dynamically, and SM 6970's logic.so exports about 2,500 symbols, including std::locale ones, from its static libstdc++. The same sm11 SM package boots on Ubuntu 24.04 with rom4s MM 1.10.6, which does not load libstdc++.
- **Fix 1: hide the static libstdc++ in every module.** Upstream added this only on master, in f2f10bc1 then 3069350d (`-Wl,--exclude-libs=libstdc++.a`). Our builder applies it only for SM ≥ 1.13, and check-package.sh currently fails any SM < 1.13 logic.so that exports fewer than 100 symbols, i.e. it fails the fixed build.
- **Fix 2: a one-line `__GNUC__ == 4` check in MM 1.10 core-legacy.** That check is only true for clang, so a GCC build hid GetGameDllBridge/GetVspBridge and dropped MM's calloc-based operator new. This is very likely why the builder insists on clang-9 for the 1.11 line (comment at builder/run/linux.sh:46-48).

`_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0` is not needed for v34. The engine, server and dedicated binaries do not link libstdc++ at all, SM's public interfaces pass no std::string, and upstream sets the define only for csgo/blade. It is left over from the gcc-4.9 sysroot, but I have not built without it yet.

The other approaches are worse:
- **Keeping Debian 11 and pinning symbol versions** (.symver / --wrap) reached only 2.18 on a toy library, because of `__cxa_thread_atexit_impl` inside libstdc++.a. Every upstream bump can add new symbols to chase.
- **Modern clang plus a CentOS 7 sysroot** gives 2.17 too, but it is more plumbing. Keep it as plan B if SM master needs a C++ language feature GCC 10 lacks. The library side is not a risk: upstream's own release builds link the same libstdc++ 10.
- **manylinux_2_28_i686** (AlmaLinux 8 i686, GCC 14.2) is a ready plan C at floor 2.28.
- **Going below 2.17 (CentOS 6, glibc 2.12)** would need a custom GCC ≥ 9 toolchain and shims for clock_gettime@2.17, secure_getenv@2.17 and aligned_alloc@2.16. Those distros have been EOL since 2017–2020, and rom4s 6572 already serves that niche.

Old-distro images still pull: centos:7, centos:6, ubuntu:12.04, 14.04, 16.04, 18.04, 20.04, debian:7, 8, 9, 10, i386/debian:8. testing/scripts/install-deps.sh needs three small fixes for them:
- an unbound array under bash 4.3 (`set -u`) at line 82;
- the CentOS 7 vault URL must be https (line 121);
- `--no-install-recommends`, because archive.debian.org 404s on some recommended X11 packages.

**Caveat:** these were container tests, so they cover old userlands only, on a 6.18 host kernel. Botplay was not run on the new builds.

facts.fact: The CS:S v34 server binaries need at most GLIBC_2.3.2. Only bin/steamclient.so (GLIBCXX_3.4, CXXABI_1.3, GCC_3.0) and libSteam2Auth.so (CXXABI_1.3) depend on libstdc++.so.6. engine/dedicated/server/tier0/vstdlib have no libstdc++ dependency and were built with GCC 2.95.3–3.4.1. libeST_SCI.so, libeST_STEAM2.so and steam_api_i486.so are statically linked against glibc (no DT_NEEDED).
facts.evidence: objdump -T / readelf -d over scratchpad/srv: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sourcemod-css34/ffbe8980-eece-56cf-8782-bc5e5af6297c/scratchpad/research/oldos/srv-floor.txt. Example lines: 'srv/bin/tier0_i486.so | GLIBC_2.3.2'; 'srv/bin/steamclient.so | GLIBC_2.3.2 GLIBCXX_3.4 CXXABI_1.3 GCC_3.0 | libm.so.6,libstdc++.so.6,libgcc_s.so.1,...'; 'srv/bin/engine_i686.so | GLIBC_2.3 | ... (no libstdc++)'.

facts.fact: So srcds v34 itself runs on any x86/x86_64 Linux with i386 glibc ≥ 2.3.2 and a 32-bit libstdc++.so.6. The practical floor is set entirely by the SM/MM builds. srcds booted and changed map on every userland I tried, from glibc 2.17 to 2.41.
facts.evidence: Smoke 'Mapchange to de_dust2' + 'Smoke test PASSED' on centos:7 (2.17), ubuntu:14.04 (2.19), debian:8 (2.19), ubuntu:16.04 (2.23), debian:9 (2.24), ubuntu:18.04 (2.27), debian:10 (2.28), ubuntu:24.04 (2.39), debian:13 (2.41). Summaries in research/oldos/oldos-cxx20-*.out and oldos-ml2014full-*.out; logs in scratchpad/smoke-oldos-cxx20-*/run.log.

facts.fact: The rom4s reference packages have floor GLIBC_2.12, set only by pthread_setname_np in sourcemod.logic.so and sourcepawn.jit.x86.so; everything else is ≤ 2.4. rom4s spcomp needs GLIBCXX_3.4.20. rom4s MM 1.10.6 binaries need ≤ GLIBC_2.3 and do not link libstdc++.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/rel-floor.txt ('addons/sourcemod/bin/sourcemod.logic.so | GLIBC_2.12'); objdump -T rel/rom4s/x/addons/sourcemod/bin/sourcemod.logic.so | grep GLIBC_2.12 -> '(GLIBC_2.12) pthread_setname_np'; readelf -d on research/oldos/x-rom4s-mm -> 'server.so: [libc.so.6] | GLIBC_2.3'.

facts.fact: The official AlliedModders Linux drops have these floors. SM 1.11.0.6970: floor 2.17 (jit clock_gettime; logic 2.12), built with clang 11 against Debian 9 (GCC 6.3) libs. SM 1.12.0.7255 and 1.13.0.7477, MM 1.12 git1227 and MM 2.0 git1476: floor 2.29–2.30, built with clang 22.1.8 against Debian 11 (GCC 10.2.1) libstdc++. Official 7477 logic.so needs pthread_cond_clockwait@GLIBC_2.30 and spcomp needs GLIBC_2.30 + GLIBCXX_3.4.26. So upstream's own release builds link libstdc++ 10.2, the same library major as devtoolset-10.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/official-floor.txt, e.g. 'x-sourcemod-1.13.0-git7477-linux ... sourcemod.logic.so | GLIBC_2.30 ... pthread_cond_clockwait@2.30'; .comment: 'GCC: (Debian 10.2.1-6) 10.2.1 20210110;clang version 22.1.8'; 6970: 'GCC: (Debian 6.3.0-18+deb9u1) 6.3.0;clang version 11.0.1'.

facts.fact: Every current css34 release package needs GLIBC_2.29. Offending symbols: log/pow/exp/log2@2.29 and logf/powf/expf@2.27 (libm, in nearly every module including MM metamod.2.ep1.so); fcntl/fcntl64@2.28 (sqlite, webternet, mysql, pgsql); getentropy@2.25 (dbi.mysql, from Debian's static OpenSSL); explicit_bzero@2.25 (dbi.pgsql, libpq); __cxa_thread_atexit_impl@2.18 (MM 2.0 KHook). spcomp needs GLIBC_2.29 + GLIBCXX_3.4.26. The sm11 MM 1.10.7 binaries (server.so, server_i486.so, metamod.1.ep1.so) have DT_NEEDED libstdc++.so.6.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/rel-floor.txt (floor2.sh over scratchpad/rel/*/x), e.g. 'sm13-latest ... dbi.mysql.ext.so | GLIBC_2.29 | ... fcntl64@2.28 fcntl@2.28 getentropy@2.25 log@2.29 ...'; 'sm11 addons/metamod/bin/server.so | NEEDED=libstdc++.so.6,libm.so.6,libgcc_s.so.1,libc.so.6'.

facts.fact: The published sm13-latest package does not load on Ubuntu 18.04 (glibc 2.27): MM fails to load and srcds exits.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/oldos-sm13pub-ubuntu-18-04.out: 'Failed to load plugin "../cstrike/addons/metamod/bin/server"', 'srcds exited while waiting for status output'. A dlopen probe in ubuntu:18.04 gave: 'metamod.2.ep1.so: dlopen: /lib/i386-linux-gnu/libm.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.29' not found'; same for sourcemod.logic.so.

facts.fact: quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_i686 is maintained and pulls. Tag 2026.10.10-1, digest sha256:30305867f278896ee117b0d162a8e4f9b7b16819e6590f6139e14c5ed5b23fdd. It is CentOS 7.9 AltArch i686 with glibc 2.17, devtoolset-10 GCC 10.2.1, git 2.56 and CPython 3.9–3.15. It has no static OpenSSL ≥1.1 and lacks perl IPC::Cmd/Time::Piece, which OpenSSL 3.x's build needs.
facts.evidence: docker inspect / quay API tag listing; docker run ... 'ls /opt/rh; gcc --version; git --version; ls /opt/python' -> devtoolset-10, 'gcc (GCC) 10.2.1 20210130 (Red Hat 10.2.1-11)', 'git version 2.56.0'; perl -MIPC::Cmd -> MISSING; rpm -q openssl-devel -> not installed.

facts.fact: Toy C++20 test (concepts, std::span, <bit>, <=>, thread_local, iostream/locale, std::thread, libm), each built as a shared library with -static-libstdc++. ml2014/GCC 10: max GLIBC_2.4, loads and runs on glibc 2.17, 2.19 and 2.12. debian:11 GCC: GLIBC_2.29. debian:11 with .symver libm pins: GLIBC_2.18 (__cxa_thread_atexit_impl from libstdc++.a), fails on 2.17. debian:12 clang + CentOS 7 sysroot: 2.4. zig cc: 2.16. Ubuntu 18.04 + GCC 13: 2.27. None of the statically linked libs needs libstdc++.so.6.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/cxx20/{t.cpp,compat.h,t_*.so,main32}; objdump -T version lists; runs: i386/debian:8 't_ml2014: ret=11 ... t_deb11: GLIBC_2.29 not found'; manylinux2014_i686 't_deb11_symver: GLIBC_2.18 not found'; centos:6 't_ml2014.so: 11 1.79176 ...'.

facts.fact: The full css34 pipeline (builder/run/linux.sh) builds SM 1.13.0.7472 + MM 1.12 git1226 in manylinux2014_i686 with real -std=c++20 (328 TUs, 0 uses of the cxx17-compat polyfill). Tweaks needed: CC/CXX=devtoolset gcc with -Wno-format-truncation -Wno-stringop-truncation (MM 1.12 -Werror on metamod.cpp:852), the devtoolset libstdc++.a path added to the hardcoded logic-link candidates, static OpenSSL 1.1.1w built from source, and the C++20→17 downgrade disabled. Result: max GLIBC_2.17 (logic clock_gettime, mysql secure_getenv), dhooks aligned_alloc@2.16, rest ≤ 2.7. check-package.sh PASSED. Build log shows the same 3 patch WARNs and 36 compiler warnings as the C++17 build.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/cxx20-build.log ('EXIT=0'); research/oldos/cxx20-floor.txt; 'Highest GLIBC symbol version referenced: 2.17 (logic: 2.17) ... Package ABI check PASSED'; diff of builder changes: research/oldos/oldos-experiment-builder.diff; build script: research/oldos/scripts/build-css34-ml2014-cxx20.sh; package: research/oldos/repo-full/packages-cxx20/.

SDK Hooks/SDK Tools/CS Tools, 17 plugins, mapchange, no SM log errors) on CentOS 7, Ubuntu 14.04, 18.04 and 24.04, and Debian 8, 9, 10 and 13. The earlier C++17 variant also passed on Ubuntu 16.04.

facts.fact: Vanilla upstream SM master tip ce7dccf (git7477) + MM 1.12-dev tip 75dd7b2 (git1227) also compile for episode1/x86 with devtoolset GCC 10.2 at -std=c++20. Only -Werror was removed; the resulting package floor is 2.17.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/src/ml2014-build.log ('MM build rc=0', 'SM build rc=0'); research/oldos/src/out-ml2014/sm-configure.log 'found gcc version 10.2, x86'; compile lines contain -std=c++20.

facts.fact: SM 1.12.0.7253 + MM 1.12 built in manylinux2014 with -Wl,--exclude-libs=libstdc++.a: max GLIBC_2.17, logic.so exports 18 dynamic symbols (0 std::locale). Smoke PASSED on CentOS 7, Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13. But check-package.sh FAILS it with 'logic.so exports only 8 defined symbols (rom4s ~285; missing libstdc++ EH exports?)': the rule at testing/scripts/check-package.sh:230-231 effectively requires the libstdc++ leak.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/sm12-build.log EXIT=0; research/oldos/oldos-sm12ml-*.out PASSED; check-package output 'FAIL: logic.so exports only 8 defined symbols'; package research/oldos/repo-full/packages-sm12/.

facts.fact: The sm11 SIGABRT on Ubuntu 24.04 needs two things together: css34 MM 1.10.7 loading libstdc++.so.6 dynamically, and SM logic.so exporting its static libstdc++ (std::locale). The sm11 SM 6970 package with rom4s MM 1.10.6 (no libstdc++ NEEDED) boots on Ubuntu 24.04; the only failure is the expected MM commit-string check. With css34 MM 1.10.7 it aborts with 'free(): invalid pointer'.
facts.evidence: scratchpad/smoke-oldos-sm11sm-rom4smm-u2404/run.log: 'Metamod:Source version 1.10.6', 'OK: SourceMod version 1.11.0.6970', 'Mapchange to de_dust2', only FAIL 'meta Built from commit nocommit'. Contrast scratchpad/smoke-sm11-u2404/run.log 'free(): invalid pointer'. readelf: rel/sm11/x/addons/metamod/bin/server.so NEEDED libstdc++.so.6.

facts.fact: I believe the mechanism is symbol interposition: default-visibility libstdc++ symbols exported from logic.so get bound to the system libstdc++.so.6 brought in by MM, mixing two locale implementations. Hiding the static copy, as upstream SM does since f2f10bc1 (#2533, 2026-09-15) narrowed by 3069350d (#2576), removes it. Neither SM 6970 nor the 1.12-dev tip 03865e00 contains that change. The css34 builder adds exclude-libs only for sm_minor ≥ 13 (builder/patches/apply-sourcemod-v112.sh:478-481).
facts.evidence: git -C tips/.../sourcemod-113 merge-base --is-ancestor f2f10bc1 <c>: 'f53cb134 lacks f2f10bc1', '03865e00 lacks f2f10bc1'; upstream AMBuildScript ce7dccff:422-423 '-static-libstdc++' + '-Wl,--exclude-libs=libstdc++.a'.

facts.fact: MM 1.10 core-legacy gates its export macro and its calloc-based operator new/delete on `__GNUC__ == 4` (or 3||4), which is true for clang but false for GCC ≥ 5. Locations: core-legacy/oslink.h:66, core-legacy/ISmmPlugin.h:384, core-legacy/sourcemm.cpp:638, core/metamod_oslink.h:93, core/metamod_oslink.cpp:97. A plain GCC 10 build therefore hides GetGameDllBridge/GetVspBridge, and srcds reports 'Failed to load plugin ../cstrike/addons/metamod/bin/server' (metamod-fatal.log: 'Detected engine 0 but could not find GetVspBridge callback'). Changing the gates to >= 4 / >= 3 fixes it. This very likely explains the clang-9 requirement (builder/run/linux.sh:46-48).
facts.evidence: First sm11 build: objdump -T metamod.1.ep1.so had no Bridge exports; scratchpad/smoke-oldos-sm11ml-dbg/metamod-fatal.log. After the fix (research/oldos/repo-full/builder/build-metamod.sh OLDOS_GNUC_FIX block): objdump shows GetGameDllBridge, GetVspBridge, _Znwj, _ZdlPv.

facts.fact: SM 1.11.0.6970 + MM 1.10.7 (css34 core-legacy transplant, dual 1.ep1/2.ep1) builds with GCC 10.2 in manylinux2014, with no clang-9 and no jessie gcc-4.9 sysroot. Changes needed: the __GNUC__ fix, -static-libstdc++ plus -Wl,--exclude-libs for every module (logic via the g++-9 wrapper), and -Wno-sign-compare. Result: max GLIBC_2.17, no MM binary needs libstdc++.so.6, logic exports 15 symbols (0 locale). Smoke PASSED on CentOS 7, Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13. check-package.sh fails only the '>=100 logic exports' rule.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/sm11b-build.log EXIT=0; research/oldos/oldos-sm11ml-{centos-7,ubuntu-24-04,debian-latest}.out 'Smoke test PASSED OK-count: 26'; script research/oldos/scripts/build-css34-ml2014-sm11.sh; package research/oldos/repo-full/packages-sm11/.

facts.fact: The v34 engine does not need _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0: no engine/server/dedicated binary links libstdc++, so no std::string crosses the engine boundary. SM's public interfaces (public/I*.h, core/logic/intercom.h) contain no std::string or other STL types. Upstream SM sets the define on Linux only for csgo/blade (AMBuildScript at f53cb134 lines ~627-630). It was needed only because of the pre-dual-ABI gcc-4.9 logic sysroot. I have not done a build without the define.
facts.evidence: srv-floor.txt NEEDED lists; git grep -nE 'std::string' ce7dccff -- public/*.h core/logic/intercom.h -> only sm_hashmap.h internals (header-only container); upstream AMBuildScript excerpt 'if sdk.name in ["csgo", "blade"]: ... _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0'.

facts.fact: spcomp built in manylinux2014 needs only GLIBCXX_3.4.19 and GLIBC_2.17: devtoolset links against the system libstdc++ 4.8.5 plus libstdc++_nonshared.a. It compiles a plugin on glibc 2.17 and 2.19. The published spcomp needs GLIBCXX_3.4.26 + GLIBC_2.29, so it won't run on Ubuntu ≤ 18.04, Debian ≤ 10 or CentOS 7.
facts.evidence: cxx20-floor.txt 'scripting/spcomp | GLIBC_2.17'; floor2 GLIBCXX list ends at 3.4.19; spcomp runs in manylinux2014_i686 and i386/debian:8 -> 'Code size: 1073 bytes ... /tmp/t.smx'.

facts.fact: For runtime dependencies on old hosts: webternet/updater use SM's bundled curl without TLS, so no host OpenSSL/libcurl is needed. dbi.mysql (SM 7461+ MariaDB Connector/C 3.4.9 prebuilt static archive) needs OpenSSL ≥ 1.1 APIs (OPENSSL_init_ssl, SSL_CTX_set_ciphersuites), which the build host must supply statically; CentOS 7 ships only 1.0.2k, so it must be built from source. The prebuilt connector archive has unversioned libc references (e.g. fcntl), so the link-time glibc decides the versions. Hosts need i386 glibc, libgcc_s.so.1, libstdc++.so.6 (steamclient, spcomp) and libz.so.1 (dbi.mysql/pgsql).
facts.evidence: nm -u dl/mariadb/.../libmariadbclient.a -> 'fcntl pthread_mutex_* ...' plus OpenSSL symbols (research/oldos/dl/mariadb/undef.txt); NEEDED lists in research/oldos/cxx20-floor.txt source (floor2.sh); builder/checkout-deps.sh:96-111.

facts.fact: Going below 2.17 is close but needs toolchain work. On CentOS 6 (glibc 2.12) the manylinux2014-built metamod.2.ep1.so dlopens fine; logic.so fails only on clock_gettime@GLIBC_2.17 (from libstdc++.a chrono). The other >2.12 symbols are secure_getenv@2.17 (mysql), aligned_alloc@2.16 (dhooks) and clock_gettime@2.17 (spcomp). manylinux2010_i686 is frozen (last tag 2022-08-05) with GCC 8.3.1, and SM's AMBuildScript rejects gcc < 9. The CentOS 6 vault needs HTTPS plus a CA bundle to install anything.
facts.evidence: centos:6 dlopen probe: 'sourcemod.logic.so: dlopen: /lib/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.17' not found'; quay API manylinux2010_i686 'last_modified: Fri, 05 Aug 2022'; 'gcc (GCC) 8.3.1 ... ldd (GNU libc) 2.12'; SM AMBuildScript:186 'if cxx.version < 'gcc-9''.

facts.fact: quay.io/pypa/manylinux_2_28_i686 exists and is maintained (tag 2026.10.10). It is AlmaLinux 8.10 i686 with gcc-toolset-14 (GCC 14.2.1) and glibc 2.28: a ready plan C if a newer GCC is ever required, at the cost of dropping CentOS 7, Ubuntu ≤ 18.04 and Debian ≤ 9.
facts.evidence: docker run quay.io/pypa/manylinux_2_28_i686 -> 'AlmaLinux release 8.10 (Cerulean Leopard) i686 gcc-toolset-14 gcc (GCC) 14.2.1 ... ldd (GNU libc) 2.28'; g++ -std=c++20 -static-libstdc++ test compiled.

facts.fact: Old-OS test images that pull with Docker 29 here: centos:7, centos:6, ubuntu:12.04/14.04/16.04/18.04/20.04, debian:7/8/9/10, i386/debian:8. Some first attempts failed transiently, and the disk was briefly full. testing/scripts/install-deps.sh has three bugs on old images: (1) line 82 `"${extra_opts[@]}"` is unbound under bash 4.3 with set -u (ubuntu:16.04: 'extra_opts[@]: unbound variable'); (2) line 121 sets the vault baseurl to http, which now 301s ('HTTPS Error 301 - Moved Permanently'); (3) installing Recommends pulls X11/tk packages that archive.debian.org 404s on (libsm6, x11-utils on jessie; xz-utils security on stretch). With fixes (`${extra_opts[@]+...}`, https, --no-install-recommends) all of them pass.
facts.evidence: research/oldos/pulls.txt, pulls2.txt; scratchpad/smoke-oldos-rom4s-ubuntu-16-04/run.log; smoke-oldos-rom4s-centos-7/run.log; debian-8/9 deps.log 404 lines (from first runs); research/oldos/oldos-install-deps.diff.

facts.fact: CI currently smokes only debian:11, debian:latest and rockylinux:9, so nothing checks the floor. check-package.sh fails on GLIBC only for ≥ 2.34. The published packages are built with rom4s clang 9.0.1 (MM, core, extensions) plus gcc-9 with gcc-4.9 static libstdc++ for logic (SM < 1.13), via legacy-build.sh (IMAGE debian:11, USE_CLANG9=1).
facts.evidence: .github/workflows/test-server.yml:209-251,484-496; testing/scripts/check-package.sh:319-353 (glibc_too_new_for_logic >= 2.34); builder/docker/legacy-build.sh:7,42; readelf -p .comment rel/sm13-latest/x/.../sourcemod.2.ep1.so -> 'clang version 9.0.1', logic -> 'GCC: (Debian 9.3.0-22) 9.3.0'; sm11/sm12 logic also 'GCC: (Debian 4.9.2-10+deb8u1) 4.9.2'.

facts.fact: Not covered by these tests. (1) Containers share the host's 6.18 kernel, so behaviour on old kernels (e.g. CentOS 7's 3.10) is untested; building against CentOS 7 kernel-headers bounds the syscall set, and SourcePawn's mimalloc has an ENOSYS fallback for getrandom. (2) Botplay/SMAC stress was not run on the manylinux2014 builds.
facts.evidence: Smoke only, via research/oldos/scripts/run-case-lite.sh; manylinux2014 kernel-headers-3.10.0-1160.62.1; sourcepawn/third_party/mimalloc/src/prim/unix/prim.c:906-914 (no_getrandom fallback).

options.title: Build all lines in quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_i686 (glibc 2.17, devtoolset-10 GCC 10.2), hidden static libstdc++
options.description: Replace the debian:11 build container with manylinux2014_i686, pinned by digest. Use the plain GCC driver: -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc -Wl,--exclude-libs=libstdc++.a for every Linux ELF, which backports upstream f2f10bc1/3069350d to 1.11/1.12. Build static OpenSSL from a pinned tarball for dbi.mysql. Keep SM 1.13 at real -std=c++20. Patch the MM 1.10 core-legacy __GNUC__==4 gates. Remove the clang-9/10 binaries from bitbucket, the jessie gcc-4.9 sysroot, the C++17 downgrade + span polyfill, and the hardcoded libstdc++.a paths.
pros: Proven here end to end on all three lines (6970+MM 1.10.7, 7253+MM 1.12, 7472+MM 1.12 C++20). Max GLIBC_2.17; smoke passes on CentOS 7 through Debian 13, including Ubuntu 24.04 where sm11 crashes today
Fixes the sm11 SIGABRT class at its root: no exported libstdc++, and no libstdc++.so.6 dependency in MM
Removes three toolchain crutches (clang-9/10 binaries with no checksums, gcc-4.9 sysroot, C++17 downgrade and polyfill)
Same libstdc++ major (10) that upstream's official release builds link, so upstream code that builds there builds here
PyPA-maintained image (tag 2026.10.10-1) with Python 3.12 and a modern git; spcomp needs only GLIBCXX_3.4.19
Same `docker run` pattern as legacy-build.sh, so no GitHub `container:` job (and its node/glibc limits) is needed
cons: GCC 10 is the compiler ceiling; a future SM master that uses newer language features would need plan B (clang + same sysroot) or C (manylinux_2_28, floor 2.28)
OpenSSL must be built from source (CentOS 7 has only 1.0.2k); OpenSSL 3.x needs perl-IPC-Cmd/perl-Time-Piece from the CentOS 7 vault
MM 1.12's -Werror trips GCC 10 format-truncation; needs -Wno-error flags (or upstream fix)
Depends on PyPA continuing to publish manylinux2014_i686, or a mirrored copy of the digest
options.risk: low-medium: smoke-proven on 10 userlands; botplay and old real kernels not yet tested

options.title: Modern clang (e.g. Debian 12/13 LLVM) + CentOS 7 i686 sysroot (glibc 2.17) + devtoolset-10 libstdc++
options.description: Cross-compile with clang --target=i686-redhat-linux --sysroot=<CentOS 7 i686 rootfs> --gcc-toolchain=<devtoolset-10>, with lld. The sysroot comes from `docker export` of manylinux2014_i686 or from extracted RPMs.
pros: Floor 2.17 (toy test: GLIBC_2.4 max, runs on 2.17)
Newest C++ language support; matches upstream's clang-based release builds
Also defines __GNUC__==4, so legacy MM 1.10 gates work without patches
cons: Library is still libstdc++ 10, so no C++ library gain over A
Two pieces to provision and pin (clang image + sysroot); AMBuild compiler detection with --target/--sysroot flags is untested at full-build scale
Not built end to end here (toy test only)

options.title: Keep debian:11 and pin symbol versions (.symver forced-include, -Wl,--wrap shims)
options.description: Force-include a header with .symver pins for libm (pow/log/exp/...@GLIBC_2.0). Add wrappers or shims for fcntl64, getentropy, explicit_bzero and __cxa_thread_atexit_impl. Rebuild or patch the prebuilt static deps (Debian's libssl.a, libpq) compiled against glibc 2.31 headers.
pros: Smallest change to the current pipeline
cons: Toy test reaches only GLIBC_2.18 (__cxa_thread_atexit_impl inside libstdc++.a); 2.17 needs a wrapper for a libstdc++-internal symbol
Pinning fcntl64→fcntl changes large-file lock semantics; getentropy/explicit_bzero need hand-written replacements
Every SM/MM bump can add new versioned references (e.g. upstream 7477 already needs pthread_cond_clockwait@2.30), so this is permanent whack-a-mole
Keeps all the existing crutches and adds more

options.title: quay.io/pypa/manylinux_2_28_i686 (AlmaLinux 8 i686, GCC 14.2, glibc 2.28)
options.description: Same approach as A, but on the 2_28 image with gcc-toolset-14.
pros: Modern GCC 14 with full C++20 and most of C++23; maintained image
Floor 2.28 still covers Debian 10+, Ubuntu 20.04+, RHEL 8+
Lower than today's 2.29, so Debian 10 gains support
cons: Drops CentOS 7, Ubuntu 14.04/16.04/18.04 and Debian 8/9, likely common on legacy v34 hosts
Not built end to end here (image toolchain verified only)

options.title: Go below 2.17 (glibc 2.12 / CentOS 6, Debian 7, Ubuntu 12.04)
options.description: Build a custom GCC ≥ 9 cross toolchain (crosstool-ng) against a CentOS 6 i686 sysroot, or keep A and add shims for clock_gettime@2.17 (inside libstdc++.a chrono), secure_getenv@2.17 and aligned_alloc@2.16. Test images would need HTTPS vault hacks.
pros: The manylinux2014 output is already close: only 4 binaries exceed 2.12
cons: No maintained build image (manylinux2010 is frozen at GCC 8.3, which SM rejects)
Hacks inside libstdc++ or a self-built toolchain to maintain
Target distros have been EOL since 2017–2020; CentOS 6 repos are barely usable for installing 32-bit runtime packages
rom4s 6572 already serves that niche

options.title: Status quo (debian:11 + clang-9 + gcc-4.9 logic sysroot, floor 2.29)
cons: Excludes CentOS 7, Ubuntu ≤ 18.04, Debian ≤ 10 (demonstrated on Ubuntu 18.04)
sm11 still SIGABRTs on Ubuntu 24.04 / Debian 13
Keeps checksum-less bitbucket clang binaries, the gcc-4.9 sysroot, the C++17 downgrade and the leak-enforcing check-package rule

recommendation:
Adopt option A and set the supported floor at glibc 2.17 for all three lines:
- **Who it covers:** CentOS/RHEL/Oracle 7+, Debian 8+, Ubuntu 14.04+, and every current distro with i386 multiarch or multilib.
- **Why not higher:** staying at 2.29 drops the very old VPS images legacy v34 servers tend to run on.
- **Why not lower:** 2.12 would need a self-maintained toolchain for distros that have been EOL for 6–9 years, and rom4s 6572 already serves them.
- **Why 2.17 is sensible:** it is better than upstream's own 2.29–2.30 and close to rom4s's practical 2.12.

Concretely:
1. Build inside quay.io/pypa/manylinux2014_i686, pinned by digest, using the devtoolset-10 GCC 10.2 driver.
2. Link libstdc++ statically and hidden in every module: `-static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc -Wl,--exclude-libs=libstdc++.a`, a backport of upstream f2f10bc1/3069350d.
3. Patch MM 1.10's `__GNUC__ == 4` gates.
4. Keep SM 1.13 at real C++20 and delete the downgrade and polyfill.
5. Retire the clang-9/10 binaries, the jessie gcc-4.9 sysroot and the hardcoded libstdc++.a paths.
6. Probably drop `_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0` too, but only behind a smoke and botplay gate.
7. Rebuild 1.11.0.6970 (with its matching MM 1.10.7) once this way, verify it, and freeze it. This also fixes the Ubuntu 24.04 crash that keeps line-sm11-oldstable withheld.

Gate every package with a static check: no ELF may need anything above GLIBC_2.17, and no libstdc++/libsupc++ symbols may be exported. Smoke-test in CI on centos:7 as the floor and on ubuntu:24.04 / debian:latest as the ceiling. Write the floor into css34-package.json and the README.

Fallbacks:
- If upstream SM master starts using a language feature GCC 10 cannot compile, switch the compiler to clang with the same CentOS 7 sysroot (option B). The library is unchanged; upstream itself ships against libstdc++ 10.
- Only if upstream moves past libstdc++ 10 in its library usage, move to manylinux_2_28_i686 (option D, floor 2.28).

questions_for_user.question: Which glibc floor should css34 Linux packages promise: 2.17 (CentOS/RHEL 7, Debian 8+, Ubuntu 14.04+), 2.28 (Debian 10+, Ubuntu 20.04+, RHEL 8+, with GCC 14), or 2.12 (CentOS 6 / Ubuntu 12.04, needs a custom toolchain)?
questions_for_user.why: It decides the build image (manylinux2014 vs manylinux_2_28 vs a custom toolchain) and which old VPS images your users can keep running. Today's packages are effectively 2.29, which excludes Ubuntu 18.04, Debian 10 and older.
questions_for_user.suggested_default: 2.17 via manylinux2014_i686: proven on all three lines here, and it covers everything still realistically in use

questions_for_user.question: For the frozen 1.11 line, should 6970 + MM 1.10.7 be rebuilt once with the new toolchain (static hidden libstdc++, GCC __GNUC__ fix) and then frozen, or should 1.11 users keep being pointed at rom4s 6572 + MM 1.10.6?
questions_for_user.why: The current 6970 release SIGABRTs on Ubuntu 24.04 / Debian 13. The rebuild passed smoke on CentOS 7, Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 13 here, but 'built once and frozen' means this is the one build that will live on.
questions_for_user.suggested_default: Rebuild 6970 once on the new toolchain, gate it with smoke + botplay on centos:7, ubuntu:24.04 and debian:latest, then freeze it and restore line-sm11-oldstable

questions_for_user.question: How much old-OS testing should CI run on every PR versus on a schedule?
questions_for_user.why: Archived mirrors (vault.centos.org, archive.debian.org) are slow and sometimes 404, so a full old-OS matrix on every PR adds minutes and flakiness.
questions_for_user.suggested_default: On every PR: centos:7 (floor) + ubuntu:24.04 + debian:latest. On release and weekly: the full sweep (ubuntu 14.04/16.04/18.04, debian 8/9/10, rockylinux:9)

questions_for_user.question: Which OpenSSL should be statically linked into dbi.mysql: keep 1.1.1 (same as today's Debian 11 build, upstream EOL since 2023) or move to a supported 3.x LTS?
questions_for_user.why: The new build image has no usable static OpenSSL, so one must be built from source either way. 3.x adds two perl build dependencies and about 1 MB to the binary.
questions_for_user.suggested_default: OpenSSL 3.5 LTS, pinned by sha256 and cached
